text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Shinko Windy's debut<n>race. Biko
Pegasus and other<n>dirt-racing friends have come to
cheer<n>her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Giddy with all the attention she's<n>getting and
determined to dominate<n>the racing world, she
places her focus<n>on making this debut count.
